notes: Encoded only from the NeoTherm page; no reuse is claimed. The page states the parent is Laars Heating Systems Co., a subsidiary of Bradford White Corp. The page lists sister/similar brands but states no shared serial system, so usesStylesOf is null and no other brand's content governs this file. Month = 1st letter digit per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping lives only in the chart image, so month is null and the style ships year-only.

styles.notes: Page example serial. Year digits are the 2nd-3rd characters (1-based page positions converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]); 00 resolves to 2000 under the 1960 floor (1900 below floor, 2000 only candidate).
